title: Menthol Protocol for Bleaching Aiptasia
author: Virginia Weis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.immcc46
materials: Drain the menthol/ASW and replace with fresh ASW.
Leave the containers overnight in the dark.

steps.title: Prepare Menthol Solution
steps.instruction: Add 1.35 mL of menthol (20 g/L) to the ASW, adding 1 drop at a time while stirring constantly with the bubbler to prevent a surface film, reaching a final concentration of 0.58 mM.

steps.title: Incubate Aiptasia
steps.instruction: Incubate the Aiptasia with the bubblers remaining inside the container for 8 hours with the lid replaced.

steps.title: Repeat Treatment
steps.instruction: Repeat the menthol addition and incubation process for three days.

steps.title: Post-Treatment Storage
steps.instruction: Store Aiptasia in the dark after the third day of treatment, noting that an extra day of exposure may be necessary.
